title: doftiles
description: personal dotfiles as a GNU stow repository: one package per directory, a makefile deployment with hooks, herbstluftwm as the window manager, and on-deploy as the one-command installer.

content.heading: doftiles - the stow packages
content: **doftiles** is the dotfiles repository: every top-level directory with dotfile content is a **GNU stow package** whose contents mirror $HOME and get symlinked into place with `stow -R -t $HOME <package>`.
deployment is selective or all at once:
`make deploy` - a tui that first configures deploy.profile (the session model, features, units and env), then stows what you pick
`make bootstrap` - the whole stack in one call
[https://github.com/akinevz2/doftiles](https://github.com/akinevz2/doftiles)

content.heading: the packages
content: **herbstluftwm** - the window manager stack: the autostart (the WM bootstrap + keybinds), the theme (theme, theme.d/titles.theme, reload_theme, winbarctl), the float machinery + focus helpers (hc_focus, hc_floatx, hc_zoom, the maximize family, the hc_center/hc_resize/hc_tile/hc_fit_to shims, hc_bounce, hc_peek, hc_full_focus), the generic hc_* and hlwm_* tools, and all systemd user units (herbst, compton, dunst, hc_send-error-daemon, xvfb, x11vnc, novnc).
**polybar** - .config/polybar (config.ini + polybar.sh + polywins.sh), polyctl, ewmh_labels, the bar control makefile; the [module/polyframes] section execs the **polyframes** binary directly.
**shell** - .bashrcx, .profile, .aliases, .exports, .zshrc, .vim, .taskrc, .my-credentials, the mimeapps/xdg plumbing, and .local/bin (install hooks, firefox wrapper, check-wsl, load-credentials).
**dunst** - .config/dunst, check-mail.sh, read-mail.sh.

**on-deploy** / **herbctl** / **herbstutil** / **polyframes** - each submodule is its own stow package: dots/<pkg>/.local/state/depends/<pkg>.makefile owns the toolchain/build/link/install recipe, the artifact lands in dots/<pkg>/.local/bin and stow ships it.
depends is remnants-only: the on.deploy shim, the per-distro <target>.deploy resolvers and .config/doftiles.conf.
**agents** - .config/opencode + .config/poolside, the opencode-screencast submodule, .local/bin and .local/share.

content.heading: how deployment works
content: every top-level directory with .config/.local content is a stow package; each package target stows it, records it as remembered (in ~/.local/state/doftiles/stowed - machine-local, the stowed set differs per host), and runs its post-stow hook.
hooks needing a running WM are guarded and no-op with a note on headless targets.

`make deploy` - selective deployment: an interactive run first walks the deploy.profile tui (distro target, session model, features, units, env) and provisions before any package is stowed; then a whiptail checklist picks the packages. `P="a b"` is the fine-grained non-interactive form; `PROFILE=skip` bypasses the profile tui.

`make install` - the single-run chain: configure (the wizard opens only on a clean install, required-file changes or doftiles.conf modifications), preserve (conflict-safe restow), packages install, status.
`make update` - the pinned-only pull (recorded submodule pins, no --remote) plus an unconditional on-deploy rebuild; no installs - `make update install` runs the install step exactly once.
bare `make` - restow exactly the remembered subset.
the service units needing X stay enabled-but-failed until X exists; the WSL2 host's herbst.service waits for the Windows-side VcXsrv X server to be reachable.

content.heading: the float registers are herbctl verbs
content: the composite mod-bindings that used to be inline herbstluftwm chains in the autostart (or dots helper scripts) are **herbctl** verbs now - the autostart spawns the compiled binary: ~/.local/bin/herbctl <verb>.

`mod-f` / float-focus, `mod-x` / float-yank, `mod-ctrl-f` / zoom - the float-register state machines (the hc_focus / hc_floatx / hc_zoom ports), plus the plain functional verbs for every navigation, split, close and toggle binding.

the full verb table lives in the [**herbctl** project](/projects/herbctl); the dots-side helpers it delegates to (hc_center, hc_tile, hc_fit_to and the maximize family) are documented in the [**polyframes** project](/projects/polyframes) - tile/center are polyframes subcommands behind two-line exec shims.

content.heading: the session model
content: deploy.profile declares how the graphical session starts:
**wsl-systemd** - no display manager: hlwm runs as the systemd user unit herbst.service, DISPLAY localhost:0.0, waiting for the Windows-side X server (VcXsrv); the WSL2 host
**greetd** - a display manager owns the console; bare-OS targets
**xinit** - startx runs ~/.xinitrc
**nested** - hlwm inside the Xvfb framebuffer, shared over VNC and browser noVNC - co-installable with a primary one, and the xrdp feature layers RDP onto the same shared framebuffer
**on-deploy** provision reads the profile and installs the per-feature platform services; the profile's units are enabled additively - activating a second profile never disables the first's.
